## 1. extract isoform_level 3UTR, 5UTR, CDS, intronic regions

#### activating conda environment

` conda activate pyscenic`

### 1.1 Gene_coordinate_genomicsRanges.R 

```R
# Set working directory

install.packages("BiocManager")
install.packages(c("dplyr", "readr", "RMariaDB"))

BiocManager::install(c(
  "GenomicFeatures",
  "GenomicRanges",
  "GenomeInfoDb",
  "AnnotationDbi",
  "rtracklayer",
  "BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38"
))

#Note, for this version we used following:
# generated by using UCSC knownGenes and hg38
genome_build <- "hg38"
ucsc_table  <- "knownGene"

txdb <- makeTxDbFromUCSC(
  genome = genome_build,
  tablename = ucsc_table
)

# also can load 'gencode.v44.annotation.gtf'
txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF(
  "gencode.v44.annotation.gtf",
  format = "gtf"
)

```

## Run
```bash
Rscript Gene_coordinate_genomicRanges_scRBP.R
```

### 1.2 bedtools --getfasta extract sequences of 3UTR, 5UTR, CDS, Intronic regions convert into .fasta files
> This part adding `-s` parameter for considering strand information to make sure the correct identification of binding sites
```bash

ref=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/

# Extract 3'UTR sequences using BED file
##------New version----2025-05-15------by adding `-name`

#3UTR
ref=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/
bedfile=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/
output=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/newVersion2_isoforms/

bedtools getfasta -fi $ref/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa -bed $bedfile/3UTRs_hg38.bed -fo $output/3UTR_transcript_regions_isoform_v2.fa -name -s


#5UTR
ref=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/
bedfile=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/
output=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/newVersion2_isoforms/

bedtools getfasta -fi $ref/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa -bed $bedfile/5UTRs_hg38.bed -fo $output/5UTR_transcript_regions_isoform_v2.fa -name -s


#CDS
ref=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/
bedfile=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/
output=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/newVersion2_isoforms/

bedtools getfasta -fi $ref/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa -bed $bedfile/CDS_hg38.bed -fo $output/CDS_transcript_regions_isoform_v2.fa -name -s


#Introns
ref=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/
bedfile=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/
output=/mnt/isilon/gandal_lab/mayl/reference/transcript_regions/newVersion2_isoforms/

bedtools getfasta -fi $ref/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa -bed $bedfile/Introns_hg38.bed -fo $output/Introns_transcript_regions_isoform_v2.fa -name -s


```
